gdpGrowth: Annual percentage growth in inflation-adjusted gross domestic product.
populationGrowth: Annual percentage growth in the total population.
sanitation: People using improved, unshared sanitation with waste safely disposed of or treated.
worldbank-catalog:bm-klt-dinv-wd-gd-zs: Highest outward foreign investment as % of GDP
Net direct investment abroad by residents, as a percentage of GDP.
worldbank-catalog:bx-klt-dinv-wd-gd-zs: Highest inward foreign investment as % of GDP
Net foreign direct investment entering the country, as a percentage of GDP.
worldbank-catalog:dt-dod-dect-gn-zs: Highest external debt as % of national income
Total debt owed to nonresidents, as a percentage of gross national income (GNI).
worldbank-catalog:dt-dod-dstc-xp-zs: Highest short-term foreign debt as % of export income
External debt due within one year, relative to exports of goods, services and primary income.
worldbank-catalog:dt-dod-pvlx-ex-zs: Highest discounted foreign debt as % of export income
Present value of external debt, relative to exports of goods, services and primary income.
worldbank-catalog:dt-dod-pvlx-gn-zs: Highest discounted foreign debt as % of national income
Present value of external debt, as a percentage of gross national income (GNI).
worldbank-catalog:dt-oda-odat-gi-zs: Highest development aid as % of capital investment
Net official development assistance received, relative to gross capital formation.
worldbank-catalog:dt-oda-odat-gn-zs: Highest development aid as % of national income
Net official development assistance received, relative to gross national income (GNI).
worldbank-catalog:dt-oda-odat-mp-zs: Highest development aid as % of imports
Net official development assistance received, relative to imports of goods, services and primary income.
worldbank-catalog:dt-tds-dect-ex-zs: Highest foreign-debt payments as % of export income
Principal and interest paid on external debt, relative to exports of goods, services and primary income.
worldbank-catalog:dt-tds-dect-gn-zs: Highest foreign-debt payments as % of national income
Principal and interest paid on external debt, relative to gross national income (GNI).
worldbank-catalog:dt-tds-dppg-gn-zs: Highest public foreign-debt payments as % of national income
Payments on public and publicly guaranteed external debt, relative to gross national income (GNI).
worldbank-catalog:er-h2o-fwtl-zs: Highest freshwater withdrawals as % of internal resources
Annual freshwater withdrawals relative to renewable internal freshwater resources; values can exceed 100%.
worldbank-catalog:fb-ast-nper-zs: Highest % of bank loans that are nonperforming
Bank loans classified as nonperforming, as a percentage of total gross loans.
worldbank-catalog:fb-bnk-capa-zs: Highest bank capital as % of assets
Bank capital relative to total bank assets, using the source's capital definition.
worldbank-catalog:fd-ast-prvt-gd-zs: Highest bank credit to the private sector as % of GDP
Credit supplied to the private sector by deposit-taking banks other than the central bank, relative to GDP.
worldbank-catalog:fd-res-liqu-as-zs: Highest bank liquid reserves as % of assets
Banks' domestic currency holdings and deposits with monetary authorities, relative to bank assets.
global-findex:account-ownership: Highest % of adults with a financial account
Adults aged 15+ with an account at a financial institution or a mobile-money provider, in the 2024 survey.
worldbank-catalog:fm-ast-cgov-zg-m3: Fastest growth rate in government credit relative to broad money
Annual percentage growth in net claims on central government relative to broad money.
worldbank-catalog:fm-ast-domo-zg-m3: Fastest growth rate in domestic credit relative to broad money
Annual percentage growth in claims on other domestic sectors relative to broad money.
worldbank-catalog:fm-ast-prvt-gd-zs: Highest monetary-sector private credit as % of GDP
Private-sector credit from monetary-sector financial institutions, relative to GDP.
worldbank-catalog:fm-ast-prvt-zg-m3: Fastest growth rate in private credit relative to broad money
Annual percentage growth in claims on the private sector relative to broad money.
worldbank-catalog:fm-lbl-bmny-zg: Annual percentage growth in broad money: currency and liquid or readily convertible financial instruments.
worldbank-catalog:fp-cpi-totl-zg: Annual percentage change in consumer prices.
worldbank-catalog:fs-ast-cgov-gd-zs: Highest net claims on government as % of GDP
Credit and other claims on central government, net of government deposits, relative to GDP.
worldbank-catalog:fs-ast-prvt-gd-zs: Highest financial-sector private credit as % of GDP
Credit supplied to the private sector by financial corporations, relative to GDP.
unsdg:three-g-coverage: Population living within reach of a third-generation mobile network, whether or not they subscribe.
unsdg:four-g-coverage: Population living within reach of a fourth-generation mobile network, whether or not they subscribe.
unsdg:five-g-coverage: Population living within reach of a fifth-generation mobile network, whether or not they subscribe.
unsdg:organized-learning: Children one year below the official primary-entry age participating in organized learning.
worldbank-catalog:eg-cft-accs-ru-zs: Highest % of rural residents using clean cooking fuels
Rural population primarily using clean fuels and technologies for cooking.
worldbank-catalog:eg-cft-accs-ur-zs: Highest % of urban residents using clean cooking fuels
Urban population primarily using clean fuels and technologies for cooking.
worldbank-catalog:eg-cft-accs-zs: Highest % of people using clean cooking fuels
Population primarily using clean fuels and technologies for cooking.
worldbank-catalog:eg-elc-accs-ru-zs: Highest % of rural residents with electricity access
Rural population with access to electricity.
worldbank-catalog:eg-elc-accs-ur-zs: Highest % of urban residents with electricity access
Urban population with access to electricity.
electricityAccess: Highest % of people with electricity access
natural-earth:most-mapped-lakes: Most lakes and reservoirs in Natural Earth's atlas
Count of lake and reservoir features covering at least 1 km² inside the country in Natural Earth 1:10m v5.0.0. This is a map inventory, not a census of every lake.
natural-earth:most-mapped-rivers: Most river features in Natural Earth's atlas
Count of river features extending at least 1 km inside the country in Natural Earth 1:10m v5.0.0. Separate features may belong to the same river.
natural-earth:longest-coastline: Longest coastline on Natural Earth's map
Coastline length measured from the fixed Natural Earth 1:10m map. Results depend on map resolution; this is not a definitive coastline length.
natural-earth:highest-coastline-density: Most coastline per km² on Natural Earth's map
Coastline length divided by land area, using the same fixed Natural Earth 1:10m map. Results depend on map resolution.
unwpp:highest-natural-change-rate: Annual births minus deaths per 1,000 people; negative values mean deaths exceed births.
unwpp:highest-net-migration-rate: Annual arrivals minus departures per 1,000 people; negative values mean more people leave than arrive.
worldbank-catalog:gc-nfn-totl-gd-zs: Highest government asset investment as % of GDP
Net government investment in nonfinancial assets, including buildings, infrastructure and inventories, relative to GDP.
worldbank-catalog:gc-rev-xgrt-gd-zs: Highest government revenue excluding grants as % of GDP
Government revenue other than grants, relative to GDP.
worldbank-catalog:gc-tax-gsrv-rv-zs: Highest goods-and-services taxes as % of government revenue
Government taxes on goods and services, relative to total government revenue.
worldbank-catalog:gc-tax-ypkg-rv-zs: Highest income and profit taxes as % of government revenue
Taxes on income, profits and capital gains, relative to total government revenue.
worldbank-catalog:gc-tax-ypkg-zs: Highest income and profit taxes as % of all taxes
Taxes on income, profits and capital gains, relative to total tax revenue.
worldbank-catalog:gc-xpn-intp-rv-zs: Highest debt interest as % of government revenue
Government interest payments on debt, relative to total government revenue.
